verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents rosbag recording/playback and a Python API for capturing data from nodes (ros2-docs-17, ros2-docs-23), which supports the 'collect robot data' half of the story, but there is no evidence of any built-in model training integration or a mechanism to push/deploy updated models back to a fleet of robots. Missing for 10: training pipeline integration, model versioning/packaging, fleet-wide model deployment/update mechanism, and any first-party or ecosystem tooling closing the loop from data to deployed model.
